h1Diagnosis.conclusion: The hot threshold interval has repeated reads/validation over constant durable state, not newly accumulating receipts or an infinite self-nested state value.
h1Diagnosis.callGraph: Each full operation verifier invokes two canonical comparisons (two Planner reads each) and one simulation transaction. Every outer local-store transaction decodes all three surfaces, including Dashboard C08. Repeating the verifier from nested case/scenario/criterion observations amplifies this fixed cost.
h1Diagnosis.causeBoundary: Inclusive trace durations overlap. They establish repeated calls and constant state, not an exclusive CPU profile. No saveCase/product mutation or foreign driver change was made.

w7FixtureChanges.minimalBootstrap: Uses exactly the published WP05 renewal source inputs: USD/2027, renewal240000, bridge60000, implementation45000, service105000, omitted/bundled training classification. Production Planner computes both initial conditioned simulations; production C08 seeds one durable case. Removes unrelated initial result publication, criterion/bindings, sensitivity samples and threshold evaluation previously built by createWp05SensitivityFixture before WP11 rebuilt them.
w7FixtureChanges.assertions: Every prior history financial/coverage/criterion/threshold/interval/retry/negative/reopen assertion is retained. Removed bootstrap work had no assertions in this history fixture and was reconstructed for the actual before/after cases anyway.
w7FixtureChanges.sourceOnlyAdmission: Strict schema decoding precedes the branch. Nonempty operations OR assumptions still use the complete production operation verifier. Empty operations/assumptions use one complete production compareForecast observation with current actor, source scope/projection and ingress/egress fences, then exact source reread and host/request checks. No target-free simulation or redundant second comparison is needed; no observation is cached between calls.
w7FixtureChanges.canonicalQuoteRevision: Uses production domain.execute Versions.copy and OPEX.save with the actual copied-line CAS version. Checks the original source projection is unchanged. Returns current source/basis/evidence hosts and supplies no calculated total; the classified Planner computes the subsequent250000/235000 scenarios.
w7FixtureChanges.sameBatchEvidence: Within one evidence.context call, identical full-reference digests share one resolver promise and each requested position receives a cloned result. The map is created and discarded per call. All subsequent calls re-resolve authority and sources; no authorization or financial result cache spans operations.
w7FixtureChanges.humanChoiceWiring: Preserves every UI/human grant, request/operation identity, command digest, source/snapshot verifier and choice method. The operational Planner uses current source authority without C10 enrichment; the judgment Planner retains original C10 coverage and criteria. API unchanged.
w7FixtureChanges.ruleBootstrap: The initial criterion rule is now registered at expectedVersion0 because the discarded WP05 bootstrap rule no longer exists. Subsequent phases still increment and register real durable rule versions.
w7FixtureChanges.newCollaboratorRestart: The seed explicitly includes collaborator as a participant. history.restart disposes the writer SQLite connection and finishes the old UI context, opens the same directory, and rebuilds UI/C08/case-port and source resolution from persisted data. The test verifies the old UI context is invalid, collaborator sees the same case/incarnation/version, original choice digest, current250000 result and one choice event; outsider is denied and revoked reader authority is denied.
w7FixtureChanges.budget: Original180000ms timeout and wall-clock guard unchanged. Incomplete work remains failure.

proofBoundaries: The WP05 source-boundary remains synthetic: references are produced by canonical projectPlannerSource plus digests and explicit fixture declarations. This path does not use the installed scoped source issuer and is not GNATIVE proof.
All monetary outputs and comparisons remain production Planner outputs. Source amount literals are input fixtures, not recomputed formulas.
The new restart proof is disposal/reopen of SQLite plus new UI/C08/reader instances in the same hosted test process. It is not a native process restart or mounted browser session.
Collaborator membership and host identity/role inputs are explicit test fixture configuration, not independent external identity-provider evidence.

AR1 nested C17/source-authority failures remain failures. Root owns the separate calculation-history and calculation-persistence follow-up; these seven history files do not establish their resolution.
No runtime success or performance improvement is asserted until hosted CI executes these exact bytes.

independentReview.findings: Canonical source-only observation keeps decode, no-operation/no-assumption scope, current source/period, compareForecast ingress/egress, exact reread and host/signal fences. Complete verifier remains for other cases. Same-batch full-reference dedup preserves order/cardinality. Bootstrap ruleVersion0 matches an empty registry; quote CAS preserves original projection. New restarted reader rebuilds UI/C08/case-port and verifies persisted membership/current Planner sources. Human grants and classified judgment remain intact.
independentReview.limitations: Runtime completion, performance, scoped issuer and native/browser authority are not established by static review.
